# Requirements Wording Checklist: Schedule Change & Trusted Record

**Purpose**: Unit-test the wording of `spec.md` itself — completeness, clarity, consistency,
measurability, and coverage — not the behavior of any implementation.
**Created**: 2026-11-16
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature
context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact.
Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is
satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements
quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Is the system's exact response defined for withdrawing a request that is not
  Pending (Agreed, Declined, Withdrawn, or Lapsed), or is "while Pending" left as the only
  stated condition with no failure path for the other four states? [Gap, Spec §FR-005]
  → Resolved: FR-005 now says Withdraw is only offered while Pending.
- [x] CHK002 Is the failure message for a missing reason on an emergency-tagged request
  specified, or does FR-014 rely on FR-003's generic "name the missing field" behavior without
  saying so explicitly? [Gap, Spec §FR-003, §FR-014]
  → Resolved: FR-014 points to FR-003's "Add a reason for the change".
- [x] CHK003 Is the system's behavior specified for a saved offline item that still cannot be
  sent once connectivity returns (e.g., the server itself is unreachable), or does FR-010 only
  cover the happy path of a successful resend? [Gap, Spec §FR-010]
  → Resolved: FR-010 keeps a failed resend saved and retries on the next connection.
- [x] CHK004 Are the Schedule, Requests, and History areas each individually specified with what
  they contain, or are they only named once as "kept separate" without per-area requirements?
  [Gap, Spec §FR-002]
  → Resolved: FR-002 now says what Schedule, Requests and History each contain.
- [x] CHK005 Is a maximum count, or any limit, specified for follow-ups on a single Pending
  request, or for dispute notes on a single emergency-tagged request? [Gap, Spec §FR-008, §FR-014]
  → Resolved: FR-008 and FR-014 say there is no limit.
- [x] CHK006 Is non-empty content required for a follow-up or a dispute note, the way it is
  explicitly required for a request's reason and a decline's reason? [Gap, Spec §FR-003, §FR-006,
  §FR-008, §FR-014]
  → Resolved: follow-ups and dispute notes now need non-empty text.

## Requirement Clarity

- [x] CHK007 Is the system's message fully specified (exact wording) for rejecting a request
  whose affected event has already started, or does FR-003 only say the system "MUST say so"
  without the literal text? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-003]
  → Resolved: FR-003 gives the exact message.
- [x] CHK008 Is the system's message fully specified (exact wording) for rejecting a new request
  because the affected entry already has a Pending request, or does FR-003 only say the system
  "MUST say so"? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-003]
  → Resolved: FR-003 gives the exact message.
- [x] CHK009 Is the list of banned "judging words" in FR-012 closed and exhaustive, or is "such
  as" wording left open-ended in a requirement that Success Criteria (SC-005) claims can be
  verified as "zero instances"? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-012, §SC-005]
  → Resolved: FR-012's word list is now closed.
- [x] CHK010 Is "the first screen" defined as a specific view distinct from (or identical to) the
  Schedule/Requests/History areas, or are the two concepts used interchangeably without a stated
  relationship? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-002]
  → Resolved: FR-002 defines the first screen as the Home summary, separate from the three areas.

## Requirement Consistency

- [x] CHK011 Is the term for the emergency marker used consistently as either "tag" or "claim"
  throughout FR-014 and the Key Entities section, or do both terms appear for what is described
  as the same field? [Consistency, Spec §FR-014]
  → Resolved: FR-014 says "tag" is the field and "claim" is how it's displayed.
- [x] CHK012 Is "the record" (used in the Assumptions, User Story 4, and FR-013) defined as the
  same thing as "Case Record Entry" (the Key Entities term for one audit event), or is it left
  unclear whether "the record" means the whole append-only ledger or a single entry in it?
  [Consistency, Spec §FR-011, §FR-013, Key Entities]
  → Resolved: Key Entities defines "Case record" as the whole list of entries.
- [x] CHK013 Does the "no more than two actions" requirement (FR-006, SC-001) apply uniformly to
  accept, plain decline, and decline-with-alternative, or is the two-action bound demonstrated
  only for the accept path and left unstated for the other two? [Consistency, Spec §FR-006,
  §SC-001]
  → Resolved: FR-006 defines the two actions for accept and decline; adding an alternative is an extra step.
- [x] CHK014 Are the wording rules in FR-012 (no judging words, no counts/scores) stated as
  applying to every status, label, and message across FR-001–FR-014 equally, or could a reader
  infer they apply only to request-outcome wording and not, for example, to delivery-failure or
  overdue messages? [Consistency, Spec §FR-012]
  → Resolved: FR-012 now applies to every label, status and message.

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [x] CHK015 Can SC-005 ("zero instances of judging language") be objectively verified given that
  the word list it depends on (FR-012) is introduced with "such as" rather than a closed set?
  [Measurability, Spec §FR-012, §SC-005]
  → Resolved: SC-005 now checks against FR-012's closed list.
- [x] CHK016 Is "usable... without horizontal scrolling or clipped content" (SC-007) specific
  enough to be checked the same way by two different reviewers, or does it still require a
  judgment call? [Measurability, Spec §SC-007]
  → Resolved: SC-007 now says the page is no wider than the viewport and every control is fully visible.
- [x] CHK017 Does every Functional Requirement (FR-001–FR-014) carry its REQ ID in the form
  "(REQ-nn)" so that FR-0nn and REQ-nn can be matched automatically, with no exceptions? [Spec
  §FR-001–FR-014, Traceability]
  → Checked: all 14 FRs carry their REQ ID.

## Scenario Coverage

- [x] CHK018 Is the "affected event is less than 24 hours away" overdue trigger in FR-008 covered
  by a worked boundary example (just under vs. just at 24 hours), the way the 48-hour-since-
  received trigger is covered by the "09:59 off / 10:00 on" example? [Gap, Spec §FR-008,
  Acceptance Examples REQ-08]
  → Resolved: added a 24-hour boundary example (18:00 off, 18:01 on).
- [x] CHK019 Is there an acceptance scenario for a second request submitted while the first is
  still Pending for the same entry (the new one-Pending-per-entry rule from Clarifications), or
  only the prose requirement in FR-003 with no worked example? [Gap, Spec §FR-003, Clarifications]
  → Resolved: added a scenario for a second request on the same exchange.
- [x] CHK020 Is there an acceptance scenario showing the full lifecycle of a decline-with-
  alternative (original Declined permanently, new linked request created with roles reversed), or
  only the prose requirement in FR-006? [Gap, Spec §FR-006, Clarifications]
  → Resolved: added a decline-with-alternative scenario.

## Edge Case Coverage

- [x] CHK021 Is the outcome specified when the sending parent tries to edit a Pending request's
  reason or affected event (fields FR-011 says are fixed), beyond simply stating those fields are
  fixed — e.g., is an edit attempt on a fixed field rejected, ignored, or is the control simply
  never offered? [Gap, Spec §FR-011]
  → Resolved: FR-011 says no edit control is offered for fixed fields.
- [x] CHK022 Is the outcome specified for an emergency-tagged request that later also becomes
  overdue (FR-008) or lapses, i.e., do the emergency and overdue/lapsed wording rules compose
  without contradiction? [Gap, Spec §FR-008, §FR-014]
  → Resolved: FR-014 says the tag and overdue/lapsed wording are shown side by side.

## Non-Functional Requirements

- [x] CHK023 Is "no real personal information" (NFR-02, carried into this spec's Assumptions)
  given any check-able criterion, or is it left to reviewer judgment what counts as personal
  information in the mock data? [Ambiguity, Spec Assumptions A-6]
  → Resolved: A-6 now limits mock data to invented names with no real contact details.

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [x] CHK024 Do FR-004 and FR-008 each clearly state that their numeric thresholds (48 h notice,
  48 h/24 h overdue) are tied to flagged working assumptions (A-3, A-4) rather than confirmed
  values, everywhere those thresholds are restated (Success Criteria, Acceptance Examples), not
  just at first definition? [Consistency, Spec §FR-004, §FR-008, §SC-002, Acceptance Examples]
  → Resolved: SC-002 and the added examples point to A-3 and A-4.

## Ambiguities & Conflicts

- [x] CHK025 Are Q-1 through Q-4 each linked to exactly one Functional Requirement so a reader
  cannot mistake which requirement's behavior is still provisional, given Q-1 and Q-3 both
  attach to FR-004? [Spec §FR-004, §FR-008, §FR-014, Assumptions]
  → Checked: Q-1 (is short notice allowed) and Q-3 (how notice is measured) are different questions that both affect FR-004, and the spec labels each one separately.

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied.
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer
  evaluation.
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers.
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify`
  and `/speckit-clarify`; this file does not replace it.
